title: fix(cli): show queued model changes and effective time
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
- Show queued visibility/pricing changes and their effective time for `my-models list`, `create` and `update`, using the shared renderer.
- Keep current values and billing units in the existing table; print concise human notices on stderr below it so table truncation cannot hide them. Include only changed supported fields, preserving zero prices; JSON stays raw and unchanged.
- Add focused real-command regressions for pending visibility/zero price, no pending change and JSON; bump CLI to `0.1.27` with its standalone lockfile.
- Validation: original queued-change regression fails; all 295 CLI tests, build and changed-file Biome checks pass. Standalone typecheck reports the same 36 baseline diagnostics, ignoring line offsets.

Fixes #16478

gist.headline: The queue gets a clock
gist.blurb: Queued model changes get their own little notice. Even a price of zero gets its moment, rather than disappearing into a table.
gist.summary: polli-cli 0.1.27 adds stderr notices for queued visibility and pricing changes, including their effective time, to `my-models list`, `create`, and `update`, while keeping current values in the table and JSON output unchanged.
gist.impact: CLI users can see supported pending changes—including zero prices—without relying on table columns that may be truncated.
gist.visual_concept: Polli checks a retro terminal showing a model table, while a separate small notice board displays a clock and queued price and visibility cards. A lime-green code-plant beside the terminal keeps the scene rooted in the garden.
